prompts.task: Run $otel-instrument against the Python service in ./service. Preserve the Click, Gunicorn, Uvicorn, and Conda product surfaces and implement the complete safe application-owned observability baseline.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service source, startup files, manifests, OBSERVABILITY.md, tests, and generated .observe artifacts.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric: Removes the process-lifetime Click parent span and gives each independently scheduled task a fresh root trace, using a span link rather than parentage only when upstream scheduling causality exists; focused telemetry tests prove multiple tasks have distinct nonzero trace IDs.

Moves provider, exporter, metric-reader, logging-bridge, and shutdown ownership into each actual web worker without creating them in a Gunicorn preload master. It keeps one owner per signal and proves the configured Gunicorn/Uvicorn worker path rather than assuming monkey patches survive every process model.

Repairs the Conda launch so customer-python resolves its own Python, opentelemetry-instrument executable, distro, and matching framework instrumentation. It records dependencies in environment.yml or another source-owned manifest and does not install into or rely on a global interpreter.

Uses OBSERVABILITY.md for organization-specific service names, approved runtime, trace boundaries, and privacy constraints while validating those facts against source. No credentials, task arguments, customer IDs, Conda prefixes, or unbounded values enter telemetry.

Runs focused tests for Click trace separation and worker-local provider ownership, then attempts full-runtime proof for automatic spans, metrics, logs, duplicate prevention, worker shutdown, and both supported web launch paths; concrete unavailable prerequisites remain Not proven rather than Working.
